_comment: Copy to push-config.json at the repo root for desktop packaging. Keep AuthKey_LKPCR48WHW.p8 and serviceAccountKey.json gitignored beside it. scripts/build-desktop.sh and build-desktop.ps1 REQUIRE these (REQUIRE_PUSH_CREDENTIALS=1) and stage them into apps/tauri/src-tauri/resources/node/ so the installed home node can push to EnvoyGo (APNs + FCM).
_comment_paths: keyPath and serviceAccountJsonPath may be absolute or relative. Relative paths resolve against the directory that contains push-config.json (repo root in dev, resources/node in a packaged app).
